Standardize provider diagnostics

Source: R/productionHardening.R
standardizeProviderDiagnostics.Rd

Converts provider diagnostic tables into a stable cross-provider schema.

Usage

standardizeProviderDiagnostics(x)

Arguments

x

Provider diagnostics data frame.

Value

Standardized provider diagnostics data frame.
